title: Exhaustive Celtic, Norse, Germanic, British & Slavic Chronicles (Prose Edda, Tacitus, Lebor Gabála Érenn, Historia Brittonum)

nodes.name: Ymir & Auðumbla → Búri → Borr & Bestla
nodes.role: Primordial Frost Giant & Ancestors of the Aesir
nodes.notes: From ice and fire in Ginnungagap emerge giant Ymir and cosmic cow Auðumbla, who licks Búri from salty ice -> Borr (+ giantess Bestla) -> Odin, Vili, and Vé! Note: Bergelmir survives the blood-deluge of Ymir in a wooden boat/box (Norse Flood motif!).

nodes.name: Odin, Vili & Vé → Ask & Embla (First Humans)
nodes.role: Creators of Midgard & First Mortal Couple
nodes.notes: Odin, Vili, and Vé shape the world from Ymir and breathe spirit, mind, and warmth into two shoreline trees (Ash & Elm) to create Ask & Embla, progenitors of humanity!

nodes.name: Thor, Baldr (→ Forseti), Týr (= Zeus/Dyaus!) & Víðarr
nodes.role: Sons of Odin & Proto-Indo-European Sky-God Týr
nodes.notes: Odin's sons include Thor (Thunder), Baldr, and Víðarr; Týr (*Tiwaz) is the EXACT Proto-Indo-European linguistic cognate of Vedic Dyaus Pitr and Greek Zeus Pater!

nodes.name: Snorri's Euhemeristic Bridge: Priam → Tror (Thor) → Voden (Odin)
nodes.role: Medieval Norse Chronicle Linking Troy & Aethiopia to Scandinavia!
nodes.notes: In his Prose Edda Prologue, Snorri Sturluson explicitly derives the Norse Aesir ('Men of Asia') from King Priam of Troy -> daughter Troan (+ King Munon/Memnon!) -> Tror (Thor) -> 18 generations -> Voden (Odin), who migrates north from Troy/Asia to Sweden and Denmark!

nodes.name: Yngvi-Freyr (Ynglings → Harald Fairhair) & Skjöldr (Scyld → Beowulf)
nodes.role: Founders of Swedish, Norwegian & Danish Dynasties
nodes.notes: Odin's lines produce Skjöldr (Scyld Scefing of Beowulf, ancestor of Danish kings), Yngvi-Freyr (Vanir son of Njörðr -> Swedish & Norwegian Yngling kings -> Harald Fairhair!), and Sigi -> Volsung -> Sigmund -> Sigurd the Dragon-Slayer!

nodes.name: Tuisto → Mannus (= Vedic Manu!) → Ingaevones, Herminones & Istaevones
nodes.role: Germanic Table of Nations & PIE Cognate of Manu!
nodes.notes: Roman historian Tacitus records ancient Germanic origin songs tracing all Germanic peoples to Earth-born Tuisto -> Mannus (EXACT Proto-Indo-European cognate of Vedic Manu!) -> three sons founding the Ingaevones (North Sea), Herminones (Central), and Istaevones (Rhine/Franks)!

nodes.name: Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel
nodes.era: Lebor Gabála Érenn (Irish Book of Invasions)
nodes.role: Descendant of Japheth/Magog & Linguistic Sage at Babel
nodes.notes: Medieval Irish chronicles trace Gaelic ancestry from Noah -> Japheth -> Magog -> Baath -> Fénius Farsaid, a Scythian king who creates the Gaelic language and Ogham script from the 72 tongues at the Tower of Babel! Father of Nel.

nodes.name: Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
nodes.role: Irish-Egyptian Chronicle Bridge (Eponym of Gaels & Scots!)
nodes.notes: Nel journeys to Egypt, befriends Moses during the Exodus, and marries Princess Scota (daughter of Pharaoh Cingris!). Their son Goídel Glas gives his name to the Gaels (Goidelic Irish & Scottish), while Scota gives her name to Scotland!

nodes.name: Breogán (Spain) → Míl Espáine → Éber Finn, Éremón & Amairgin (Milesians)
nodes.role: Ancestors of the Gaelic Irish & Scottish High Kings
nodes.notes: Descended from Goídel Glas -> Sru -> Éber Scot -> Breogán (builder of the Tower of Brigantia in Galicia, Spain) -> Míl Espáine! His sons Éber Finn, Éremón, and poet-druid Amairgin sail from Spain to Ireland and defeat the Tuatha Dé Danann.

nodes.name: Cessair, Partholón, Nemed & Tuatha Dé Danann (Danu, Dagda, Lugh, Brigid)
nodes.notes: Begins with Noah's granddaughter Cessair arriving in Ireland before the Flood, followed by Partholón, Nemed, Fir Bolg, and the divine Tuatha Dé Danann (Danu, The Dagda, Nuada, Brigid, and sun-hero Lugh -> father of Cú Chulainn!).

nodes.name: Niall of the Nine Hostages (Uí Néill) & Fergus Mór → Kenneth MacAlpin
nodes.role: Irish High Kings & 1st King of Scots
nodes.notes: Milesian royal lines produce Niall of the Nine Hostages (ancestor of the Uí Néill High Kings of Ireland) and Fergus Mór of Dál Riata -> Kenneth MacAlpin (Cináed mac Ailpín, unifier of Picts & Scots, 843 CE!).

nodes.name: Brutus of Troy → Locrinus (England), Camber (Wales) & Albanactus (Scotland)
nodes.era: Historia Brittonum (9th c.) & Geoffrey of Monmouth
nodes.role: Trojan Eponym of Britain & Tripartite Division of the Island
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Trojan prince Aeneas (via Ascanius -> Silvius -> Brutus); leads Trojan exiles to Albion, renames it Britain, founds Troia Nova (London), and divides the island among his 3 sons: Locrinus, Camber, and Albanactus!

nodes.name: King Lear (Leir) → Beli Mawr → Uther Pendragon → King Arthur
nodes.notes: Continuation of Brutus's British chronicle through King Leir (Shakespeare's Lear), Welsh ancestor Beli Mawr, Cassivellaunus, and Uther Pendragon to King Arthur of Camelot.

nodes.name: Perun & Veles / Lech (Poland), Czech (Bohemia) & Rus (Rus')
nodes.era: Slavic Origin Chronicles (Primary Chronicle / Great Poland Chronicle)
nodes.notes: The Slavic tripartite origin legend traces Poland (Lech), Bohemia/Czechia (Czech), and Rus' (Rus) to three brothers; the Russian Primary Chronicle explicitly assigns all Slavic peoples to Japheth's portion of Earth!
